title.narrative: The project for promoting the inclusive and sustainable development of the yellowfin tuna value chain in Chabahar

description.narrative: This project aims to support the construction of a sustainable and comprehensive yellowfin tuna value chain, as well as enhance regional economies through the development of the fisheries industry, including maintaining a sustainable fisheries resource management system and building a comprehensive business system. This project not only contributes to the fisheries development of Iran, but also strengthens the economic relations between the two countries through supporting the overseas expansion of related Japanese SMEs, providing high quality yellowfin tuna to Japan.
